text: 金十数据11月6日讯，根据《中华人民共和国证券投资基金法》《公开募集证券投资基金管理人监督管理办法》（证监会令第198号，经证监会令第227号修改）和《合格境内机构投资者境外证券投资管理试行办法》（证监会令第46号）等有关规定，经审核，核准路博迈基金管理（中国）有限公司作为合格境内机构投资者从事境外证券投资管理业务，公司应当据此办理变更业务范围手续。
text_en: Jinshi Data, November 6: In accordance with relevant provisions of the Securities Investment Fund Law of the People's Republic of China, the Measures for the Supervision and Administration of Publicly Offered Securities Investment Fund Managers (CSRC Order No. 198, amended by CSRC Order No. 227), and the Trial Measures for the Administration of Overseas Securities Investment by Qualified Domestic Institutional Investors (CSRC Order No. 46), and after review, Neuberger Berman Fund Management (China) Co., Ltd. is approved to engage in overseas securities investment management business as a qualified domestic institutional investor, and the company shall accordingly complete procedures to change its business scope.
